notes.title: Rubber Brawl is joining IndieCade 2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

IndieCade, the festival dedicated to indie games, is coming back with a special event on Steam! For one week, the nominees of the previous editions will be highlighted, as well as the new games developed by the winning studios. 

And Rubber Brawl is joining the party, don't forget to wishlist! 

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/5419830/sale/indiecade2022 ]here to access the event page[/url]. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/f7466feb3d1991f417cbf973cfbda0bd24c89f48.png[/img]


Rubber Brawl is a crazy 32-player Brawler Royale where you play as... tires! Overcome the laws of physics to drive your tire to victory, and knock down your opponents along the way to be the last one standing.

If you have a question, you can pop into [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]our Discord server[/url] or write us on the Steam forums or at contact@rubberbrawl-thegame.com. 


See you soon! 
Team Piece of Cake studios

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is over, thank you all!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Steam Next Fest is now over, and it was an incredible week! [b]Thousands of you have downloaded Rubber Brawl demo[/b], just woooow! Thank you to everyone who has played it so far!! We hope you had as much fun tracing your way through the cosmic dump as we had developing it. 

The demo is now disabled so we can continue our work on it. It will probably be available again at the end of the month. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/4a55f2aae86d0b9d584959a5cc90a9c10fc360b3.gif[/img]

Also, we would like [b]thank you for all the feedbacks we received via the bug report, the Steam forums or Discord[/b] since the release of the demo! 

We read them carefully and we tried to fix as many bugs as possible to improve the demo. Thanks to you,, we have released several patches during the festival to fix blocking bugs, improve the controls, and optimize the game. 

Of course, Rubber Brawl is still in the early stages of its journey, and this playable demo was a first look at it. Our work on Rubber Brawl is not over yet and we'll continue to prepare it for an upcoming Early Access release. In the coming months, our main goals are to add the multiplayer, improbe the game feel, controls and global optimation of the game + add new features like customization and active skills. 



In the meantime, feel free to pop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]Discord[/url] to talk with us about Rubber Brawl! 

Oh! And if you haven’t already wishlisted the game, we’d love it if you did:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: try Rubber Brawl demo now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The Steam Next Fest has just started and it’s the perfect occasion to discover the first playable demo of Rubber Brawl! You can download it on the Steam page below, go try it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/bfc26d8eed987090b395324aafcff5dfc9e27d48.png[/img]


[h2] What is Rubber Brawl? [/h2]
Rubber Brawl is a crazy 32-player Brawler Royale where you play as... tires! Overcome the laws of physics to drive your tire to victory, and knock down your opponents along the way to be the last one standing.

Rubber Brawl is still in development and this playable demo is not representative of the final state of the game. We will continue to improve it over the next few months to prepare its release in Early Access. 

This demo will allow us to test the main features of the game and we will soon publish a roadmap of the future content we plan to add: bonuses and skills, customization, multiplayer co-op and matchmaking... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/d16725ca95e45c9233ec9a8a24ca914ea9259dfd.png[/img]


[h2] Any bug or feedback? [/h2]
We have integrated a special interface in the demo to make it easier for you to report bugs. At any time during your game, you can activate it to report a bug you encounter without leaving the game. 

You can also report them on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]our Discord server[/url].

We are also looking forward to your feedback on the demo! Here is a quick survey you can fill out to tell us more, it’s [url=https://forms.gle/1i4zus2S3hCWLzpo9]available here[/url].

You can also pop into [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]our Discord[/url] if you want to talk with us and provide any comments and feedback there. 



If you have a question, you can also write us on the Steam forums or at contact@rubberbrawl-thegame.com

And if you haven’t yet wishlisted Rubber Brawl on Steam, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/]click here[/url].

Roll safely! 
Piece of Cake studios team

notes.title: Welcome to Rubber Brawl!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to Rubber Brawl! 

Here at Piece of Cake studios, we often come up with crazy project ideas, and time to time we decide to make them happen! This is how [b]Rubber Brawl[/b] is born, our new multiplayer [b]Brawler Royale[/b] with... pumped-up tires!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/d16725ca95e45c9233ec9a8a24ca914ea9259dfd.png[/img]


Get ready for a chaotic brawl battle where every bend can be fatal. In a cosmic dump with up to 32 players, overcome the laws of physics to drive your tire to victory, and knock down your opponents along the way.  

The game is still in development and we will continue to improve it over the next few months, until it's ready to release in Early Access. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/c1c3b805dc3f4df1a8fde006e4fe1c83f9088cb6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/2882f66bac6f52334d9663fed657bf38c1c681fa.gif[/img]


We'll be be part of Steam Next Fest in two weeks and a[b] playable demo will be available[/b] for the duration of the event, so if you've ever dreamed of a battle at the top between tires, get ready! The event starts Monday 3rd October. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/bfc26d8eed987090b395324aafcff5dfc9e27d48.png[/img]


Until then, [b]go wishlist the game on Steam[/b] :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/



See you soon, and roll safely! 

[i]Team Piece of Cake studios[/i]
